source.notes: No official marking scheme is published with this paper; questions carry no official answer. Genuine ICSE 2025 board examination paper from the CISCE Archive Library bundle 'ICSE-MainExamination2025.zip'; every page is footed 'T25 522' (used as paperCode). Maximum Marks 80, Time allowed Two hours. Section A (Questions 1–2, 40 marks) is compulsory; Section B (Questions 3–8, 10 marks each) says 'Attempt any four questions', so the printed marks in this pack total 100 (40 + 6×10), as expected. Question 1's fifteen MCQ/assertion-reason items share one printed [15] (1 mark each). Question 2's [5] groups (ii), (iii) and (v) were split into 1-mark items; 2 (i) (diagram-based) and 2 (iv) (matching) are kept whole. Section B items are kept at the roman-numeral level where marks are printed. Chemical subscripts, superscripts and ionic charges were rebuilt as Unicode from the PDF layout (small lowered/raised glyphs checked with pdfplumber) and flagged; reaction arrows are Wingdings glyphs (or, in 4 (ii)(a), a drawn arrow) that pdftotext drops, rebuilt as '→' and flagged. The paper ends with a stray '`' character on page 16, ignored.
